newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Buba's Issing says new rate cuts counterproductive.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Issing says new rate cuts counterproductive.

text.p: Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing said a further cut in interest rates by Germany's central bank would be counterprodutive in the current economic environment.

Issing also said in a speech to Swiss bankers that the conditions for a continuation of Germany's economic recovery were in place and he saw no signs of exchange rate tension in Europe in light of the dollar's strength.
